# FLX-5033: a correlation property is incompletely declared

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §2: a correlation property declares two columns and a minVariance. Without the second column there is nothing to correlate; without the variance floor the encoding error on a correlation has no bound (KERNEL-SPEC §12), so no margin can be compiled.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5033
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
